title: Girls on horseback turned back on her birthday
summary: Scott Ramsay tells of Girls on horseback turned back on her birthday, about March 25, 1948 at New Mexico (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: road to Hart Canyon, Aztec, New Mexico

tellings.quote: how do you know it was March 25th?" And she said, "Cuz it was my birthday."

plain: Scott Ramsay, who researches a flying saucer said to have crashed near Aztec, New Mexico in 1948, tells what a woman told him. She said that she and other girls riding horses were turned back on the road to Hart Canyon, where the crash is said to have happened. When he asked how she knew the date was March 25, 1948, she answered that it was her birthday, which if true pins the crash to that day.
